_schema: id, pattern, quote, source, authority, note. 재도입 금지 대상 (CLAUDE.md §3).
_note: 전부 계약 원문에서 기계 추출했다. authority=contract 는 AGENTS.md/BRIEF/START_PROMPT 원문 근거를 뜻한다.

pattern: Rejected: a "management platform" with lots of widgets
quote: The user does not want a “management platform” with lots of widgets.
reason: Explicit exclusion: "does not want". Same sentence as CORE-07; listed separately because it excludes a direction rather than prescribing one.

quote:
## 2.2 Rejected: card-heavy “workflow dashboard”

Rejected because it made the user inspect too many components before understanding the situation.
reason: Heading says "Rejected"; stated reason: "it made the user inspect too many components before understanding the situation."

Item of the "Do **not** add:" list opened at line 82; reason at line 95 ("the system cannot know the true project progress merely from checked steps"). Restated in AGENTS.md:22 item 2 ("Do not add KPI cards...") and again as "KPI tiles" in §4.3 line 177.
Item of the "Do **not** add:" list (line 82); reason at line 95. Restated in AGENTS.md:22 item 2 ("progress percentages") and in CODEX_START_PROMPT.txt:7.
Item of the "Do **not** add:" list (line 82); reason at line 95. AGENTS.md:22 names "progress percentages" and "analytics" but not "progress bars" verbatim — the brief's ban stands on its own.
Item of the "Do **not** add:" list (line 82); reason at line 95. Restated verbatim in AGENTS.md:22 item 2 ("“external waiting”").
Item of the "Do **not** add:" list (line 82); reason at line 95. Restated verbatim in AGENTS.md:22 item 2 ("“within 7 days”").
Item of the "Do **not** add:" list (line 82); reason at line 95. AGENTS.md:22 covers it under "other invented management states".

Item of the "Do **not** add:" list (line 82); reason at line 95. Restated in AGENTS.md:22 item 2 ("charts") and again in §4.3 line 178 — but §4.3's copy is scoped "On the default main view" while this one is unscoped (see internal conflicts).
Item of the "Do **not** add:" list (line 82); reason at line 95. Restated in AGENTS.md:22 item 2 ("analytics") and CODEX_START_PROMPT.txt:7 ("analytics").

Item of the "Do **not** add:" list (line 82); reason at line 95. Hardened by AGENTS.md:46 ("Do not assign arbitrary colors per vendor.") and restated as "multicolor vendor coding" in §4.3 line 175; CODEX_START_PROMPT.txt:7 also names "vendor color coding".
Final item of the "Do **not** add:" list (line 82); reason at line 95. Restated in AGENTS.md:22 item 2 ("or other invented management states").

pattern: Rejected direction: line-item table as the main dashboard
quote:
## 2.3 Rejected: line-item table as the main dashboard

A compact table improved density but still failed the user’s request because the desired mental model is **calendar-based schedule management**, not a spreadsheet substitute.
reason: Heading says "Rejected"; stated reason: the table "failed the user’s request" because the mental model is calendar-based, "not a spreadsheet substitute". Note the concession that it "improved density" does not soften the rejection.

pattern: Rejected: calendar events that show D-day instead of task names
quote: ## 2.4 Rejected: calendar events that show D-day instead of task names
reason: Heading says "Rejected". Hardened by AGENTS.md:23 item 3 ("The calendar event text must show **`vendor name · actual schedule/task name`**, not `D-?`") and AGENTS.md:24 item 4.

pattern: Wrong calendar event label form: vendor · D-n
reason: Labelled "**Wrong**" under a heading that begins "Rejected". AGENTS.md:23-24 items 3-4 restate it as binding ("not `D-?`"; D-day "not inside the calendar event label").

pattern: Rejected: treating glanceability as showing more metrics
reason: Explicit exclusion in bold ("does **not** mean") of the metric-adding reading of the glanceability requirement.

pattern: Rejected: panels that appear/disappear and shift the layout for routine actions
quote: - Avoid panels that appear/disappear and shift the whole layout for routine actions.
reason: "Avoid" — an exclusion of a pattern (the same verb that opens the §4.3 noise-budget bans at line 171), though the contract does not word it as "must not".

pattern: Rejected on the default main view: multiple badge systems
reason: Item of the "On the default main view, avoid:" list opened at line 171 — the ban is scoped to the default main view. AGENTS.md:47 restates it unscoped and hedged: "Avoid nested cards and excessive badges/chips."

pattern: Rejected on the default main view: decorative icons in every row
reason: Item of the "On the default main view, avoid:" list (line 171). Not restated in AGENTS.md.

pattern: Rejected on the default main view: multicolor vendor coding
reason: Item of the "On the default main view, avoid:" list (line 171); duplicated unscoped at §2.2 line 92 ("vendor color palettes") and hardened unscoped by AGENTS.md:46 ("Do not assign arbitrary colors per vendor.").

pattern: Rejected on the default main view: status legends
reason: Item of the "On the default main view, avoid:" list (line 171). Related to AGENTS.md:22 item 2's ban on "status dashboards" and "invented management states".

pattern: Rejected on the default main view: KPI tiles
reason: Item of the "On the default main view, avoid:" list (line 171); the unscoped form is §2.2 line 84 ("KPI cards") and AGENTS.md:22 item 2 ("Do not add KPI cards").

pattern: Rejected on the default main view: charts
reason: Item of the "On the default main view, avoid:" list (line 171); the unscoped form is §2.2 line 90 and AGENTS.md:22 item 2 ("charts").

pattern: Rejected on the default main view: non-essential secondary filters
quote: - secondary filters that are not essential.
reason: Final item of the "On the default main view, avoid:" list (line 171). "essential" is left undefined — the contract gives no test for which filters survive; CODEX_START_PROMPT.txt:7 uses the phrasing "arbitrary status filters".

quote: Do not add global metrics to the header.
reason: "Do not add ..." explicit feature exclusion. AGENTS.md:22 (non-negotiable item 2) is the harder restatement: "Do not add KPI cards, progress percentages, analytics, charts, status dashboards ... or other invented management states."

quote: Overdue dates naturally appear before today; do not create a separate status category/tab.
reason: "do not create" excludes a UI construct. Matches §2.2's rejected "within 7 days" status categories and AGENTS.md:22 (item 2, no invented management states).

pattern: No progress bar / health status / state badge on cards
quote: No progress bar. No project-health status. No invented state badge.
reason: Explicit exclusions. §2.2 lists progress bars, progress percentages and arbitrary health scores among rejected directions; AGENTS.md:22 (item 2) restates the prohibition as non-negotiable.

pattern: No large later-items list on the main card
quote: If the same vendor has several later items, do not clutter the main card with a large list.
reason: "do not clutter ... with a large list" excludes that card element. AGENTS.md:40 (item 15) supports it: "Prefer fewer controls, stable placement, and progressive disclosure over feature visibility." What size counts as "a large list" is not defined.

pattern: No D-day in the calendar event label
quote: Do **not** include D-day in the event label.
reason: Emphasized binding "Do **not**". AGENTS.md:24 (item 4) restates it: "D-day belongs in the **left vendor cards and detail surfaces**, not inside the calendar event label"; §2.4 records D-day-in-event-label as an already-rejected direction.

pattern: No multi-step wizard for Add Schedule
quote: Do not force the user through a multi-step wizard.
reason: Excludes a flow pattern outright. Consistent with AGENTS.md:13 ("Using the app must not become another job") and AGENTS.md:40 (item 15).

pattern: No rich-text document editor for the log
quote: Do not turn it into a rich-text document editor unless the user later asks for one.
reason: Explicit exclusion of a feature, with a conditional escape ("unless the user later asks for one") that has not been exercised in the frozen contract.

quote: Do not calculate or display a percentage from step count.
reason: Explicit exclusion; §2.2 lists progress percentages among rejected directions and states the user objected because "the system cannot know the true project progress merely from checked steps"; AGENTS.md:22 (item 2) restates the prohibition.

pattern: No progress/finished dashboard indicator on main screen
quote: Do not invent a progress/finished dashboard indicator on the main screen.
reason: Explicit exclusion of an invented indicator; matches §2.2 rejected directions and AGENTS.md:22 (item 2, "other invented management states").

quote: - Do not introduce React/Vue/Svelte solely for fashion.
reason: Explicit "Do not introduce" prohibition, qualified by "solely for fashion"; the narrow exception is stated separately in the next sentence of the same line (DAT-48).

pattern: Not flashy; not a 'startup analytics dashboard'
reason: The words 'not ... not ...' exclude these directions outright. Reinforced by AGENTS.md:44 'not a decorative consumer dashboard' and AGENTS.md item 2's ban on analytics/dashboards.

quote: Do not use a different accent color for every vendor.
reason: 'Do not' is an explicit prohibition; AGENTS.md:46 restates it as 'Do not assign arbitrary colors per vendor.'

The clause excludes this direction; the verb is 'Avoid' (softer than 'do not', but still an exclusion of a named visual direction). Adjacent in spirit to AGENTS.md:47 'Avoid nested cards and excessive badges/chips.'

pattern: No progress %, KPI, invented state badge, or analytics in the D-day rail
quote: - [ ] No progress %, KPI, invented state badge, or analytics appear.
reason: The criterion excludes these elements outright ('No ... appear'); AGENTS.md item 2 restates it harder: 'Do not add KPI cards, progress percentages, analytics, charts, status dashboards, “external waiting”, “within 7 days”, or other invented management states.'

pattern: D-day must not be substituted for the task name in the calendar
quote: - [ ] Calendar does not substitute D-day for the task name.
reason: The criterion excludes D-day-as-calendar-label; AGENTS.md items 3 and 4 restate the prohibition ('not `D-?`'; 'D-day belongs in the left vendor cards and detail surfaces, not inside the calendar event label').

pattern: No progress percentage derived from step count
quote: - [ ] No progress percentage is derived from step count.
reason: Explicit exclusion ('No progress percentage is derived'); AGENTS.md item 2 forbids 'progress percentages' outright, and §22 A line 998 repeats the ban for the rail.
